+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg;
+
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.CommittedTarget;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.math.Vec3;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.GearEffectSnapshot;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.GearInstance;
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.UUID;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+/** Test-only access to the existing support harness and its real SupportRuntime owner. */
+public final class MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper {
+    private MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper() { }
+
+    public static void verify(String id,String skill,GearInstance item,GearEffectSnapshot accepted,
+                              GearEffectSnapshot unrolled) {
+        var h=new Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness(skill) {
+            @Override public List<UUID> enemies(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double radius) {
+                return List.of();
+            }
+            @Override public double itemAuraActivationCost(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                return c.profile().resourceCost();
+            }
+            @Override public boolean payItemAuraActivation(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                double cost=c.profile().resourceCost();
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+            @Override public boolean upkeep(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double seconds,int quantum) {
+                double cost=c.profile().support().upkeepPerSecond()*seconds;
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+        };
+        var ally=UUID.randomUUID();var unrelated=UUID.randomUUID();
+        h.members.add(ally);
+        assertEquals(0,unrolled.value(id),1e-9);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+        var target=new CommittedTarget(h.world,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.FORWARD,h.actor);
+        var context=h.execution.itemAura(h.world,h.actor,item.identity(),skill,accepted,h,target);
+        assertEquals("ACTIVE",h.runtime.activateItemAura(context,item.identity(),false,0,h));
+        assertEquals(1,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,true);
+        h.runtime.endItemAura(h.actor,item.identity(),skill,"SOURCE_REMOVED",h);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+    }
+
+    private static void assertEffect(String id,Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness h,UUID ally,
+                                     UUID unrelated,boolean active) {
+        if(id.equals("WA-149")) {
+            assertEquals(active,h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).isPresent());
+            assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,unrelated,0).isEmpty());
+            if(active)assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).orElseThrow().magnitude()>0);
+        } else {
+            assertEquals(active?.15:0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(ally,0),1e-9);
+            assertEquals(0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(unrelated,0),1e-9);
+        }
+    }
+}

+        assertTrue(positive.gearSucceeded(),id);
+        assertEquals("CHANCE_MISS",control.gate(),id);

+            assertEquals("APPLIED",positive.periodicResult(),id);
+            assertEquals(1,positivePeriodic.size(),id);
+            assertEquals(0,controlPeriodic.size(),id);
+        } else {
+            assertTrue(positiveStatuses.inspect(victim).active().containsKey(type),id);
+            assertFalse(controlStatuses.inspect(victim).active().containsKey(type),id);
+        }

+            assertEquals("EMPTY_SLOT",withdrawn.code());

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg;
+
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.CommittedTarget;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.math.Vec3;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.GearEffectSnapshot;

+import java.util.UUID;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+/** Test-only access to the existing support harness and its real SupportRuntime owner. */
+public final class MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper {
+    private MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper() { }
+
+    public static void verify(String id,String skill,GearInstance item,GearEffectSnapshot accepted,
+                              GearEffectSnapshot unrolled) {
+        var h=new Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness(skill) {
+            @Override public List<UUID> enemies(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double radius) {
+                return List.of();
+            }
+            @Override public double itemAuraActivationCost(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                return c.profile().resourceCost();
+            }
+            @Override public boolean payItemAuraActivation(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                double cost=c.profile().resourceCost();
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+            @Override public boolean upkeep(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double seconds,int quantum) {
+                double cost=c.profile().support().upkeepPerSecond()*seconds;
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+        };
+        var ally=UUID.randomUUID();var unrelated=UUID.randomUUID();
+        h.members.add(ally);
+        assertEquals(0,unrolled.value(id),1e-9);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+        var target=new CommittedTarget(h.world,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.FORWARD,h.actor);
+        var context=h.execution.itemAura(h.world,h.actor,item.identity(),skill,accepted,h,target);
+        assertEquals("ACTIVE",h.runtime.activateItemAura(context,item.identity(),false,0,h));
+        assertEquals(1,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,true);
+        h.runtime.endItemAura(h.actor,item.identity(),skill,"SOURCE_REMOVED",h);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+    }
+
+    private static void assertEffect(String id,Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness h,UUID ally,
+                                     UUID unrelated,boolean active) {
+        if(id.equals("WA-149")) {
+            assertEquals(active,h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).isPresent());
+            assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,unrelated,0).isEmpty());
+            if(active)assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).orElseThrow().magnitude()>0);
+        } else {
+            assertEquals(active?.15:0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(ally,0),1e-9);
+            assertEquals(0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(unrelated,0),1e-9);
+        }
+    }

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg;
+
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.CommittedTarget;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.math.Vec3;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.GearEffectSnapshot;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.GearInstance;
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.UUID;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+/** Test-only access to the existing support harness and its real SupportRuntime owner. */
+public final class MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper {
+    private MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper() { }
+
+    public static void verify(String id,String skill,GearInstance item,GearEffectSnapshot accepted,
+                              GearEffectSnapshot unrolled) {
+        var h=new Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness(skill) {
+            @Override public List<UUID> enemies(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double radius) {
+                return List.of();
+            }
+            @Override public double itemAuraActivationCost(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                return c.profile().resourceCost();
+            }
+            @Override public boolean payItemAuraActivation(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                double cost=c.profile().resourceCost();
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+            @Override public boolean upkeep(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double seconds,int quantum) {
+                double cost=c.profile().support().upkeepPerSecond()*seconds;
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+        };
+        var ally=UUID.randomUUID();var unrelated=UUID.randomUUID();
+        h.members.add(ally);
+        assertEquals(0,unrolled.value(id),1e-9);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+        var target=new CommittedTarget(h.world,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.FORWARD,h.actor);
+        var context=h.execution.itemAura(h.world,h.actor,item.identity(),skill,accepted,h,target);
+        assertEquals("ACTIVE",h.runtime.activateItemAura(context,item.identity(),false,0,h));
+        assertEquals(1,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,true);
+        h.runtime.endItemAura(h.actor,item.identity(),skill,"SOURCE_REMOVED",h);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+    }
+
+    private static void assertEffect(String id,Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness h,UUID ally,
+                                     UUID unrelated,boolean active) {
+        if(id.equals("WA-149")) {
+            assertEquals(active,h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).isPresent());
+            assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,unrelated,0).isEmpty());
+            if(active)assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).orElseThrow().magnitude()>0);
+        } else {
+            assertEquals(active?.15:0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(ally,0),1e-9);
+            assertEquals(0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(unrelated,0),1e-9);
+        }
+    }

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg;
+
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.CommittedTarget;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.math.Vec3;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.GearEffectSnapshot;

+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.UUID;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+/** Test-only access to the existing support harness and its real SupportRuntime owner. */
+public final class MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper {
+    private MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper() { }
+
+    public static void verify(String id,String skill,GearInstance item,GearEffectSnapshot accepted,
+                              GearEffectSnapshot unrolled) {
+        var h=new Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness(skill) {
+            @Override public List<UUID> enemies(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double radius) {
+                return List.of();
+            }
+            @Override public double itemAuraActivationCost(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                return c.profile().resourceCost();
+            }
+            @Override public boolean payItemAuraActivation(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                double cost=c.profile().resourceCost();
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+            @Override public boolean upkeep(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double seconds,int quantum) {
+                double cost=c.profile().support().upkeepPerSecond()*seconds;
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+        };
+        var ally=UUID.randomUUID();var unrelated=UUID.randomUUID();
+        h.members.add(ally);
+        assertEquals(0,unrolled.value(id),1e-9);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+        var target=new CommittedTarget(h.world,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.FORWARD,h.actor);
+        var context=h.execution.itemAura(h.world,h.actor,item.identity(),skill,accepted,h,target);
+        assertEquals("ACTIVE",h.runtime.activateItemAura(context,item.identity(),false,0,h));
+        assertEquals(1,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,true);
+        h.runtime.endItemAura(h.actor,item.identity(),skill,"SOURCE_REMOVED",h);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+    }
+
+    private static void assertEffect(String id,Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness h,UUID ally,
+                                     UUID unrelated,boolean active) {
+        if(id.equals("WA-149")) {
+            assertEquals(active,h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).isPresent());
+            assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,unrelated,0).isEmpty());
+            if(active)assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).orElseThrow().magnitude()>0);
+        } else {
+            assertEquals(active?.15:0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(ally,0),1e-9);
+            assertEquals(0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(unrelated,0),1e-9);
+        }
+    }
+}

+/** Test-only access to the existing support harness and its real SupportRuntime owner. */
+public final class MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper {
+    private MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper() { }
+
+    public static void verify(String id,String skill,GearInstance item,GearEffectSnapshot accepted,
+                              GearEffectSnapshot unrolled) {
+        var h=new Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness(skill) {
+            @Override public List<UUID> enemies(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double radius) {
+                return List.of();
+            }
+            @Override public double itemAuraActivationCost(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                return c.profile().resourceCost();
+            }
+            @Override public boolean payItemAuraActivation(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                double cost=c.profile().resourceCost();
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+            @Override public boolean upkeep(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double seconds,int quantum) {
+                double cost=c.profile().support().upkeepPerSecond()*seconds;
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+        };
+        var ally=UUID.randomUUID();var unrelated=UUID.randomUUID();
+        h.members.add(ally);
+        assertEquals(0,unrolled.value(id),1e-9);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+        var target=new CommittedTarget(h.world,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.FORWARD,h.actor);
+        var context=h.execution.itemAura(h.world,h.actor,item.identity(),skill,accepted,h,target);
+        assertEquals("ACTIVE",h.runtime.activateItemAura(context,item.identity(),false,0,h));
+        assertEquals(1,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,true);
+        h.runtime.endItemAura(h.actor,item.identity(),skill,"SOURCE_REMOVED",h);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+    }
+
+    private static void assertEffect(String id,Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness h,UUID ally,
+                                     UUID unrelated,boolean active) {
+        if(id.equals("WA-149")) {
+            assertEquals(active,h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).isPresent());
+            assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,unrelated,0).isEmpty());
+            if(active)assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).orElseThrow().magnitude()>0);
+        } else {
+            assertEquals(active?.15:0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(ally,0),1e-9);
+            assertEquals(0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(unrelated,0),1e-9);
+        }
+    }
+}

+# Final affix controls (offline)
+
+Owned files: `src/test/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/gear/MasterAffixFinalControlsTest.java`, test-only `src/test/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper.java`, and this note. No production, registry, gate, proof-map, or existing test file was edited.
+
+Every positive uses `MasterAffixTestEquipment.fixture(id, false)` and the corresponding unrolled control uses `fixture(id, true)`. The test asserts production `GearDropGenerator.eligible`, then admits both through public `GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(level, baseline, candidates)`, which uses `GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED`. It asserts the accepted item and frozen value, and checks that a nonequipped candidate is rejected as `NOT_EQUIPPED` with no effects. It does not use `MasterAffixTestEquipment.accepted`, whose current overload supplies candidate capabilities. All IDs below are enabled and none is WA-155.
+
+| ID | New method / actual owner proof | Remaining boundary |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| WA-008 | `wa008NativeGearActionProfilesPrimaryChangesRenderedAnimationFromAcceptedUnrolled`: `NativeGearActionProfiles.primary` selects the accepted frozen rate; the actual family `NativePrimaryActionAssets.renderAnimations` changes attack animation speed; the accepted unrolled item keeps its original root (`primary` rejects variant selection). | Native asset publication, client animation, and contact were not run. |
+| WA-014 | `wa014NativeGearActionProfilesPrimaryChangesRenderedReachFromAcceptedUnrolled`: `NativeGearActionProfiles.primary` selects frozen reach; the actual family `NativePrimaryActionAssets.renderNode` extends an authored melee selector while the zero-reach render is unchanged. | Native selector collision, wall and victim traces were not run. |
+| WA-016 | `wa016NativeAffixProjectileTravelLaunchExtendsSamePathOnlyForAcceptedRoll`: same launch inputs return no override for the unrolled item and a longer `NativeAffixProjectileTravel.Launch` for the rolled item; the real `Path` admits the new endpoint and terminates there. Instant-line is excluded. | Native projectile spawn, physics tick and impact were not run. |
+| WA-053 | `gearStatusRuntimeAdmitSameHitUnrolledAndProtectedOrChanceMiss(WA-053)`: real `GearStatusRuntime.admit` enters `PeriodicStatusRuntime` for Bleed once. | Native hit producer and Sentinel inheritance were not run. |
+| WA-054 | Same parameterized method `(WA-054)`: Burn enters `PeriodicStatusRuntime` once. | Same boundary. |

Periodic cases assert one package in `PeriodicStatusRuntime` and zero in the control; control cases assert target status in `StatusService` only for the positive.

This was an isolated JVM run; no Gradle, game, server, authentication, deployment, commit, worker, JUnit XML, or connected validation was run. No cases were skipped as already proved but unregistered.

+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.math.Vec3;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.GearEffectSnapshot;

+import java.util.UUID;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

+/** Test-only access to the existing support harness and its real SupportRuntime owner. */
+public final class MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper {
+    private MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper() { }
+
+    public static void verify(String id,String skill,GearInstance item,GearEffectSnapshot accepted,
+                              GearEffectSnapshot unrolled) {
+        var h=new Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness(skill) {
+            @Override public List<UUID> enemies(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double radius) {
+                return List.of();
+            }
+            @Override public double itemAuraActivationCost(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                return c.profile().resourceCost();
+            }
+            @Override public boolean payItemAuraActivation(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                double cost=c.profile().resourceCost();
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+            @Override public boolean upkeep(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double seconds,int quantum) {
+                double cost=c.profile().support().upkeepPerSecond()*seconds;
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+        };
+        var ally=UUID.randomUUID();var unrelated=UUID.randomUUID();
+        h.members.add(ally);
+        assertEquals(0,unrolled.value(id),1e-9);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+        var target=new CommittedTarget(h.world,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.FORWARD,h.actor);
+        var context=h.execution.itemAura(h.world,h.actor,item.identity(),skill,accepted,h,target);
+        assertEquals("ACTIVE",h.runtime.activateItemAura(context,item.identity(),false,0,h));
+        assertEquals(1,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,true);
+        h.runtime.endItemAura(h.actor,item.identity(),skill,"SOURCE_REMOVED",h);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+    }
+
+    private static void assertEffect(String id,Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness h,UUID ally,
+                                     UUID unrelated,boolean active) {
+        if(id.equals("WA-149")) {
+            assertEquals(active,h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).isPresent());
+            assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,unrelated,0).isEmpty());
+            if(active)assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).orElseThrow().magnitude()>0);
+        } else {
+            assertEquals(active?.15:0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(ally,0),1e-9);
+            assertEquals(0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(unrelated,0),1e-9);
+        }
+    }
+}

+    void gearStatusRuntimeAdmitSameHitUnrolledAndProtectedOrChanceMiss(String id,RpgStatusType type,Channel channel) {
+        var p=pair(id);

+        var hit=new GearStatusRuntime.AppliedHit(actor,"root","strike",victim,true,true,true,false,10,1,Map.of(channel,10d));
+        var positiveStatuses=new StatusService(CombatBalanceProfile.loadCanonical(),()->0);
+        var controlStatuses=new StatusService(CombatBalanceProfile.loadCanonical(),()->0);
+        var positivePeriodic=new PeriodicStatusRuntime<String,String>();
+        var controlPeriodic=new PeriodicStatusRuntime<String,String>();
+        PeriodicStatusRuntime.Port<String,String> port=new PeriodicStatusRuntime.Port<>() {
+            public boolean tick(PeriodicStatusRuntime.Source s,String c,String t,int i,double coefficient,double seconds){return true;}
+            public void changed(PeriodicStatusRuntime.Source s,String t,PeriodicStatusRuntime.View v) { }
+        };
+        GearStatusRuntime.PeriodicAdmission positiveOwner=(kind,h,source)->GearStatusRuntime.applyPeriodic(
+                positivePeriodic,new PeriodicStatusRuntime.Source(actor,"root",victim,kind),"cast","victim",
+                10,10,4,1,1,0,port,source);
+        GearStatusRuntime.PeriodicAdmission controlOwner=(kind,h,source)->GearStatusRuntime.applyPeriodic(
+                controlPeriodic,new PeriodicStatusRuntime.Source(actor,"root",victim,kind),"cast","victim",
+                10,10,4,1,1,0,port,source);
+        var positive=GearStatusRuntime.admit(positiveStatuses,new GearStatusRuntime.Contacts(),hit,type,
+                ControlProfile.NORMAL,p.positive(),p.positive(),GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY,0,0,0,0,positiveOwner,
+                "fixture_skill",false,1);
+        var control=GearStatusRuntime.admit(controlStatuses,new GearStatusRuntime.Contacts(),hit,type,
+                ControlProfile.NORMAL,p.control(),p.control(),GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY,0,0,0,0,controlOwner,
+                "fixture_skill",false,1);
+        assertEquals("ADMITTED",positive.gate(),id);
+        assertTrue(positive.gearSucceeded(),id);
+        assertEquals("CHANCE_MISS",control.gate(),id);
+        if(type==RpgStatusType.BLEED||type==RpgStatusType.BURN||type==RpgStatusType.POISON) {
+            assertEquals("APPLIED",positive.periodicResult(),id);
+            assertEquals(1,positivePeriodic.size(),id);
+            assertEquals(0,controlPeriodic.size(),id);
+        } else {
+            assertTrue(positiveStatuses.inspect(victim).active().containsKey(type),id);
+            assertFalse(controlStatuses.inspect(victim).active().containsKey(type),id);
+        }
+        var missed=GearStatusRuntime.admit(new StatusService(CombatBalanceProfile.loadCanonical(),()->0),
+                new GearStatusRuntime.Contacts(),hit,type,ControlProfile.NORMAL,p.positive(),p.positive(),
+                GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY,0,0,.999,0,positiveOwner,"fixture_skill",false,1);
+        assertEquals("CHANCE_MISS",missed.gate(),id);
+        var protectedHit=new GearStatusRuntime.AppliedHit(actor,"root","strike",victim,true,true,true,true,10,1,
+                Map.of(channel,10d));
+        assertEquals("INELIGIBLE_HIT",GearStatusRuntime.admit(new StatusService(CombatBalanceProfile.loadCanonical(),()->0),
+                new GearStatusRuntime.Contacts(),protectedHit,type,ControlProfile.NORMAL,p.positive(),p.positive(),
+                GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY,0,0,0,0,positiveOwner,"fixture_skill",false,1).gate(),id);
+    }

+                    new SkillInstanceLifecycle(),ignored->{});
+            class Resources implements NativeResourcePort {
+                double stamina=100;
+                public double current(ResourceType type){return type==ResourceType.STAMINA?stamina:100;}
+                public double maximum(ResourceType type){return 100;}
+                public void setCurrent(ResourceType type,double value){if(type==ResourceType.STAMINA)stamina=value;}
+            }
+            var resources=new Resources();
+            var weapon=new SkillExecutionPort.Item("test:battleaxe","BATTLEAXE",
+                    new ItemPowerDescriptor("test:battleaxe",Set.of("BATTLEAXE"),10d,null));
+            class Port implements SkillExecutionPort {
+                SkillExecutionContext committed;
+                public boolean actorAliveAndUsable(){return true;}

+# Final affix controls (offline)
+
+Owned files: `src/test/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/gear/MasterAffixFinalControlsTest.java`, test-only `src/test/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper.java`, and this note. No production, registry, gate, proof-map, or existing test file was edited.
+
+Every positive uses `MasterAffixTestEquipment.fixture(id, false)` and the corresponding unrolled control uses `fixture(id, true)`. The test asserts production `GearDropGenerator.eligible`, then admits both through public `GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(level, baseline, candidates)`, which uses `GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED`. It asserts the accepted item and frozen value, and checks that a nonequipped candidate is rejected as `NOT_EQUIPPED` with no effects. It does not use `MasterAffixTestEquipment.accepted`, whose current overload supplies candidate capabilities. All IDs below are enabled and none is WA-155.
+
+| ID | New method / actual owner proof | Remaining boundary |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| WA-008 | `wa008NativeGearActionProfilesPrimaryChangesRenderedAnimationFromAcceptedUnrolled`: `NativeGearActionProfiles.primary` selects the accepted frozen rate; the actual family `NativePrimaryActionAssets.renderAnimations` changes attack animation speed; the accepted unrolled item keeps its original root (`primary` rejects variant selection). | Native asset publication, client animation, and contact were not run. |
+| WA-014 | `wa014NativeGearActionProfilesPrimaryChangesRenderedReachFromAcceptedUnrolled`: `NativeGearActionProfiles.primary` selects frozen reach; the actual family `NativePrimaryActionAssets.renderNode` extends an authored melee selector while the zero-reach render is unchanged. | Native selector collision, wall and victim traces were not run. |
+| WA-016 | `wa016NativeAffixProjectileTravelLaunchExtendsSamePathOnlyForAcceptedRoll`: same launch inputs return no override for the unrolled item and a longer `NativeAffixProjectileTravel.Launch` for the rolled item; the real `Path` admits the new endpoint and terminates there. Instant-line is excluded. | Native projectile spawn, physics tick and impact were not run. |
+| WA-053 | `gearStatusRuntimeAdmitSameHitUnrolledAndProtectedOrChanceMiss(WA-053)`: real `GearStatusRuntime.admit` enters `PeriodicStatusRuntime` for Bleed once. | Native hit producer and Sentinel inheritance were not run. |
+| WA-054 | Same parameterized method `(WA-054)`: Burn enters `PeriodicStatusRuntime` once. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-055 | Same parameterized method `(WA-055)`: Poison enters `PeriodicStatusRuntime` once. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-057 | Same parameterized method `(WA-057)`: Electrified enters `StatusService`. | Native target projection and Sentinel inheritance were not run. |
+| WA-058 | Same parameterized method `(WA-058)`: Slow enters `StatusService`. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-059 | Same parameterized method `(WA-059)`: Stun enters `StatusService`. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-060 | Same parameterized method `(WA-060)`: Silence enters `StatusService`. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-061 | Same parameterized method `(WA-061)`: Blind enters `StatusService`. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-062 | Same parameterized method `(WA-062)`: Fear enters `StatusService`. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-063 | Same parameterized method `(WA-063)`: Root enters `StatusService`. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-144 | `wa144SkillExecutionServiceRequestSameActorUnrolledRejectedAndAcceptedGrantExecutes`: fixture grants its authored `axe_toss` selector; the same actor/request is rejected with the unrolled item, committed through `SkillExecutionService.request` after accepted publication, and rejected with `EMPTY_SLOT` after unrolled publication. | Native item transaction and connected projectile release were not run. |
+| WA-149 | `wa149SupportRuntimeThornsRecipientEffectRemovalAndNoAuraActor`: accepted item context activates real `SupportRuntime`; an ally receives positive `thorns`, an unrelated actor receives none, and removal clears the ally effect. | `SupportRuntime.activateItemAura` accepts a caller-supplied item context; this test does not prove the native Hytale support selector suppresses unrolled activation. Native reflection delivery was not run. |
+| WA-150 | `wa150SupportRuntimePedanticismRecipientEffectRemovalAndNoAuraActor`: accepted item context activates real `SupportRuntime`; an ally gets 0.15 cooldown recovery, an unrelated actor gets zero, and removal clears the ally effect. | Same selector boundary; native cooldown use was not run. |
+
+For each parameterized status case, the exact same `AppliedHit` (actor, root, strike, victim, channel and draw) is supplied to separate positive and unrolled owner instances. The positive is `ADMITTED`, the unrolled control is `CHANCE_MISS`, a high draw on the rolled source is `CHANCE_MISS`, and a protected hit is `INELIGIBLE_HIT`. Periodic cases assert one package in `PeriodicStatusRuntime` and zero in the control; control cases assert target status in `StatusService` only for the positive.
+
+Direct `javac --release 25 -sourcepath ''` compiled the two new test sources against current local classes/resources, cached dependency JARs and the installed public Hytale server JAR. Direct JUnit Platform Launcher via the existing `NativeActionJUnitRunner` found **16 tests, 16 passed, 0 failed**. This was an isolated JVM run; no Gradle, game, server, authentication, deployment, commit, worker, JUnit XML, or connected validation was run. No cases were skipped as already proved but unregistered.

+package com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg;
+
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.CommittedTarget;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.math.Vec3;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.GearEffectSnapshot;
+import com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.gear.GearInstance;
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.UUID;
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+/** Test-only access to the existing support harness and its real SupportRuntime owner. */
+public final class MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper {
+    private MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper() { }
+
+    public static void verify(String id,String skill,GearInstance item,GearEffectSnapshot accepted,
+                              GearEffectSnapshot unrolled) {
+        var h=new Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness(skill) {
+            @Override public List<UUID> enemies(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double radius) {
+                return List.of();
+            }
+            @Override public double itemAuraActivationCost(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                return c.profile().resourceCost();
+            }
+            @Override public boolean payItemAuraActivation(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                double cost=c.profile().resourceCost();
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+            @Override public boolean upkeep(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double seconds,int quantum) {
+                double cost=c.profile().support().upkeepPerSecond()*seconds;
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+        };
+        var ally=UUID.randomUUID();var unrelated=UUID.randomUUID();
+        h.members.add(ally);
+        assertEquals(0,unrolled.value(id),1e-9);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+        var target=new CommittedTarget(h.world,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.FORWARD,h.actor);
+        var context=h.execution.itemAura(h.world,h.actor,item.identity(),skill,accepted,h,target);
+        assertEquals("ACTIVE",h.runtime.activateItemAura(context,item.identity(),false,0,h));
+        assertEquals(1,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,true);
+        h.runtime.endItemAura(h.actor,item.identity(),skill,"SOURCE_REMOVED",h);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+    }
+
+    private static void assertEffect(String id,Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness h,UUID ally,
+                                     UUID unrelated,boolean active) {
+        if(id.equals("WA-149")) {
+            assertEquals(active,h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).isPresent());
+            assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,unrelated,0).isEmpty());
+            if(active)assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).orElseThrow().magnitude()>0);
+        } else {
+            assertEquals(active?.15:0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(ally,0),1e-9);
+            assertEquals(0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(unrelated,0),1e-9);
+        }
+    }
+}

+    @MethodSource("statusCases")
+    void gearStatusRuntimeAdmitSameHitUnrolledAndProtectedOrChanceMiss(String id,RpgStatusType type,Channel channel) {
+        var p=pair(id);
+        var actor=UUID.randomUUID();var victim=UUID.randomUUID();
+        var hit=new GearStatusRuntime.AppliedHit(actor,"root","strike",victim,true,true,true,false,10,1,Map.of(channel,10d));
+        var positiveStatuses=new StatusService(CombatBalanceProfile.loadCanonical(),()->0);
+        var controlStatuses=new StatusService(CombatBalanceProfile.loadCanonical(),()->0);
+        var positivePeriodic=new PeriodicStatusRuntime<String,String>();
+        var controlPeriodic=new PeriodicStatusRuntime<String,String>();
+        PeriodicStatusRuntime.Port<String,String> port=new PeriodicStatusRuntime.Port<>() {
+            public boolean tick(PeriodicStatusRuntime.Source s,String c,String t,int i,double coefficient,double seconds){return true;}
+            public void changed(PeriodicStatusRuntime.Source s,String t,PeriodicStatusRuntime.View v) { }
+        };
+        GearStatusRuntime.PeriodicAdmission positiveOwner=(kind,h,source)->GearStatusRuntime.applyPeriodic(
+                positivePeriodic,new PeriodicStatusRuntime.Source(actor,"root",victim,kind),"cast","victim",
+                10,10,4,1,1,0,port,source);
+        GearStatusRuntime.PeriodicAdmission controlOwner=(kind,h,source)->GearStatusRuntime.applyPeriodic(
+                controlPeriodic,new PeriodicStatusRuntime.Source(actor,"root",victim,kind),"cast","victim",
+                10,10,4,1,1,0,port,source);
+        var positive=GearStatusRuntime.admit(positiveStatuses,new GearStatusRuntime.Contacts(),hit,type,
+                ControlProfile.NORMAL,p.positive(),p.positive(),GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY,0,0,0,0,positiveOwner,
+                "fixture_skill",false,1);
+        var control=GearStatusRuntime.admit(controlStatuses,new GearStatusRuntime.Contacts(),hit,type,
+                ControlProfile.NORMAL,p.control(),p.control(),GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY,0,0,0,0,controlOwner,
+                "fixture_skill",false,1);
+        assertEquals("ADMITTED",positive.gate(),id);
+        assertTrue(positive.gearSucceeded(),id);
+        assertEquals("CHANCE_MISS",control.gate(),id);
+        if(type==RpgStatusType.BLEED||type==RpgStatusType.BURN||type==RpgStatusType.POISON) {
+            assertEquals("APPLIED",positive.periodicResult(),id);
+            assertEquals(1,positivePeriodic.size(),id);
+            assertEquals(0,controlPeriodic.size(),id);
+        } else {
+            assertTrue(positiveStatuses.inspect(victim).active().containsKey(type),id);
+            assertFalse(controlStatuses.inspect(victim).active().containsKey(type),id);
+        }
+        var missed=GearStatusRuntime.admit(new StatusService(CombatBalanceProfile.loadCanonical(),()->0),
+                new GearStatusRuntime.Contacts(),hit,type,ControlProfile.NORMAL,p.positive(),p.positive(),
+                GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY,0,0,.999,0,positiveOwner,"fixture_skill",false,1);
+        assertEquals("CHANCE_MISS",missed.gate(),id);
+        var protectedHit=new GearStatusRuntime.AppliedHit(actor,"root","strike",victim,true,true,true,true,10,1,
+                Map.of(channel,10d));
+        assertEquals("INELIGIBLE_HIT",GearStatusRuntime.admit(new StatusService(CombatBalanceProfile.loadCanonical(),()->0),
+                new GearStatusRuntime.Contacts(),protectedHit,type,ControlProfile.NORMAL,p.positive(),p.positive(),
+                GearEffectSnapshot.EMPTY,0,0,0,0,positiveOwner,"fixture_skill",false,1).gate(),id);
+    }

+# Final affix controls (offline)
+
+Owned files: `src/test/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/gear/MasterAffixFinalControlsTest.java`, test-only `src/test/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper.java`, and this note. No production, registry, gate, proof-map, or existing test file was edited.
+
+Every positive uses `MasterAffixTestEquipment.fixture(id, false)` and the corresponding unrolled control uses `fixture(id, true)`. The test asserts production `GearDropGenerator.eligible`, then admits both through public `GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(level, baseline, candidates)`, which uses `GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED`. It asserts the accepted item and frozen value, and checks that a nonequipped candidate is rejected as `NOT_EQUIPPED` with no effects. It does not use `MasterAffixTestEquipment.accepted`, whose current overload supplies candidate capabilities. All IDs below are enabled and none is WA-155.
+
+| ID | New method / actual owner proof | Remaining boundary |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| WA-008 | `wa008NativeGearActionProfilesPrimaryChangesRenderedAnimationFromAcceptedUnrolled`: `NativeGearActionProfiles.primary` selects the accepted frozen rate; the actual family `NativePrimaryActionAssets.renderAnimations` changes attack animation speed; the accepted unrolled item keeps its original root (`primary` rejects variant selection). | Native asset publication, client animation, and contact were not run. |
+| WA-014 | `wa014NativeGearActionProfilesPrimaryChangesRenderedReachFromAcceptedUnrolled`: `NativeGearActionProfiles.primary` selects frozen reach; the actual family `NativePrimaryActionAssets.renderNode` extends an authored melee selector while the zero-reach render is unchanged. | Native selector collision, wall and victim traces were not run. |
+| WA-016 | `wa016NativeAffixProjectileTravelLaunchExtendsSamePathOnlyForAcceptedRoll`: same launch inputs return no override for the unrolled item and a longer `NativeAffixProjectileTravel.Launch` for the rolled item; the real `Path` admits the new endpoint and terminates there. Instant-line is excluded. | Native projectile spawn, physics tick and impact were not run. |
+| WA-053 | `gearStatusRuntimeAdmitSameHitUnrolledAndProtectedOrChanceMiss(WA-053)`: real `GearStatusRuntime.admit` enters `PeriodicStatusRuntime` for Bleed once. | Native hit producer and Sentinel inheritance were not run. |
+| WA-054 | Same parameterized method `(WA-054)`: Burn enters `PeriodicStatusRuntime` once. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-055 | Same parameterized method `(WA-055)`: Poison enters `PeriodicStatusRuntime` once. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-057 | Same parameterized method `(WA-057)`: Electrified enters `StatusService`. | Native target projection and Sentinel inheritance were not run. |
+| WA-058 | Same parameterized method `(WA-058)`: Slow enters `StatusService`. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-059 | Same parameterized method `(WA-059)`: Stun enters `StatusService`. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-060 | Same parameterized method `(WA-060)`: Silence enters `StatusService`. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-061 | Same parameterized method `(WA-061)`: Blind enters `StatusService`. | Same boundary. |
+| WA-062 | Same parameterized method `(WA-062)`: Fear enters `StatusService`. | Same boundary. |

+
+For each parameterized status case, the exact same `AppliedHit` (actor, root, strike, victim, channel and draw) is supplied to separate positive and unrolled owner instances. The positive is `ADMITTED`, the unrolled control is `CHANCE_MISS`, a high draw on the rolled source is `CHANCE_MISS`, and a protected hit is `INELIGIBLE_HIT`. Periodic cases assert one package in `PeriodicStatusRuntime` and zero in the control; control cases assert target status in `StatusService` only for the positive.

+    public static void verify(String id,String skill,GearInstance item,GearEffectSnapshot accepted,
+                              GearEffectSnapshot unrolled) {
+        var h=new Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness(skill) {
+            @Override public List<UUID> enemies(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double radius) {
+                return List.of();
+            }
+            @Override public double itemAuraActivationCost(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                return c.profile().resourceCost();
+            }
+            @Override public boolean payItemAuraActivation(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                double cost=c.profile().resourceCost();
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+            @Override public boolean upkeep(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double seconds,int quantum) {
+                double cost=c.profile().support().upkeepPerSecond()*seconds;
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+        };
+        var ally=UUID.randomUUID();var unrelated=UUID.randomUUID();
+        h.members.add(ally);
+        assertEquals(0,unrolled.value(id),1e-9);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+        var target=new CommittedTarget(h.world,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.FORWARD,h.actor);
+        var context=h.execution.itemAura(h.world,h.actor,item.identity(),skill,accepted,h,target);
+        assertEquals("ACTIVE",h.runtime.activateItemAura(context,item.identity(),false,0,h));
+        assertEquals(1,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,true);
+        h.runtime.endItemAura(h.actor,item.identity(),skill,"SOURCE_REMOVED",h);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+    }
+
+    private static void assertEffect(String id,Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness h,UUID ally,
+                                     UUID unrelated,boolean active) {
+        if(id.equals("WA-149")) {
+            assertEquals(active,h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).isPresent());
+            assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,unrelated,0).isEmpty());
+            if(active)assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).orElseThrow().magnitude()>0);
+        } else {
+            assertEquals(active?.15:0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(ally,0),1e-9);
+            assertEquals(0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(unrelated,0),1e-9);
+        }
+    }

+# Final affix controls (offline)
+
+Owned files: `src/test/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/gear/MasterAffixFinalControlsTest.java`, test-only `src/test/java/com/inigmasgames/hytalerpg/MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper.java`, and this note. No production, registry, gate, proof-map, or existing test file was edited.

+Every positive uses `MasterAffixTestEquipment.fixture(id, false)` and the corresponding unrolled control uses `fixture(id, true)`. The test asserts production `GearDropGenerator.eligible`, then admits both through public `GearEquipmentResolution.resolve(level, baseline, candidates)`, which uses `GearAffixRuntime.ENABLED`. It asserts the accepted item and frozen value, and checks that a nonequipped candidate is rejected as `NOT_EQUIPPED` with no effects. It does not use `MasterAffixTestEquipment.accepted`, whose current overload supplies candidate capabilities. All IDs below are enabled and none is WA-155.

+/** Test-only access to the existing support harness and its real SupportRuntime owner. */
+public final class MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper {
+    private MasterAffixFinalAuraHelper() { }
+
+    public static void verify(String id,String skill,GearInstance item,GearEffectSnapshot accepted,
+                              GearEffectSnapshot unrolled) {
+        var h=new Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness(skill) {
+            @Override public List<UUID> enemies(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double radius) {
+                return List.of();
+            }
+            @Override public double itemAuraActivationCost(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                return c.profile().resourceCost();
+            }
+            @Override public boolean payItemAuraActivation(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c) {
+                double cost=c.profile().resourceCost();
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+            @Override public boolean upkeep(com.inigmasgames.hytalerpg.execution.SkillExecutionContext c,double seconds,int quantum) {
+                double cost=c.profile().support().upkeepPerSecond()*seconds;
+                if(mana<cost)return false;
+                mana-=cost;
+                return true;
+            }
+        };
+        var ally=UUID.randomUUID();var unrelated=UUID.randomUUID();
+        h.members.add(ally);
+        assertEquals(0,unrolled.value(id),1e-9);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+        var target=new CommittedTarget(h.world,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.ZERO,Vec3.FORWARD,h.actor);
+        var context=h.execution.itemAura(h.world,h.actor,item.identity(),skill,accepted,h,target);
+        assertEquals("ACTIVE",h.runtime.activateItemAura(context,item.identity(),false,0,h));
+        assertEquals(1,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,true);
+        h.runtime.endItemAura(h.actor,item.identity(),skill,"SOURCE_REMOVED",h);
+        assertEquals(0,h.runtime.auraCount());
+        assertEffect(id,h,ally,unrelated,false);
+    }
+
+    private static void assertEffect(String id,Stage09SupportRuntimeTest.Harness h,UUID ally,
+                                     UUID unrelated,boolean active) {
+        if(id.equals("WA-149")) {
+            assertEquals(active,h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).isPresent());
+            assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,unrelated,0).isEmpty());
+            if(active)assertTrue(h.runtime.thorns(h.world,ally,0).orElseThrow().magnitude()>0);
+        } else {
+            assertEquals(active?.15:0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(ally,0),1e-9);
+            assertEquals(0,h.runtime.cooldownRecoveryIncreased(unrelated,0),1e-9);
+        }
+    }
